title: Superhost Travel Credit Perk Table — Host Accounts
content:
# Host Accounts — Superhost Travel Credit Perk

The Roamhaven travel credit is a perk of the Superhost tier. The table states, for each host tier of Host Accounts, the travel credit amount the tier carries and the number of consecutive met Superhost assessments that earn one credit.

| Host tier | Travel credit amount of the tier | Consecutive met assessments that earn one credit |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | USD 0.00 (not a perk of the tier) | 4 |
| Standard Host | USD 0.00 (not a perk of the tier) | 4 |
| Superhost | USD 100.00 | 4 |
| Professional Host | USD 0.00 (not a perk of the tier) | 4 |
| Professional Host Plus | USD 0.00 (not a perk of the tier) | 4 |
| Enterprise Partner | USD 0.00 (not a perk of the tier) | 4 |

A tier listed at USD 0.00 carries no travel credit perk. The credit is a Roamhaven travel credit, not cash.
